messages:
kevin_release: Quick heads-up — planning a staged tilt of the router pool for the payments rollout in the 02:00 UTC change window. Target model: router-service v2.5.4 pinned. plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with slow drain between steps. will run webhook smoke after each step.

amy_sre: Ack. What drain timeout are we using? last slow drain was 120s and we saw some uncovered connections.

chris_engineering: propose 180s drain + 30s warmup per step. tilt increments every 5m after check. keep cookie affinity on for sessions.

jordan_platform: Re: cookie affinity — we should enable session affinity for the canary cohort to avoid flapping. I'll set it on the LB before tilt.

kevin_release: plan details:
```
- router image: registry.redwood/router:v2.5.4
- tilt steps: 10%, 25%, 50%, 100%
- drain: 180s
- wait between steps: 5m + smoke checks (latency p99 < 1200ms, error rate < 0.5%)
- fallback: immediate revert to 0% if smoke fails
- rollout owner: @kevin_release
```

deploy-bot: deploy request received: `deploy router-service --image=registry.redwood/router:v2.5.4 --tilt=staged --steps=10,25,50,100 --drain=180s`

deploy-bot: step 0: preflight checks OK. infra-health OK, route table ready, warm nodes: 5 available. starting tilt at 02:00:00 UTC.

amy_sre: pinging observability — please stand by for tracing and kube-probe checks.

pagerbot: [02:01:12 UTC] Deploy monitor: smoke check 10% -> OK. p50 120ms, p95 310ms, p99 980ms, errors 0.12%.

deploy-bot: step 1 complete: 10% -> 25% in progress. applying tilt to router-lb-eu-west.

chris_engineering: noticed slightly higher connections on backend B during 25% shift, but within expected. continuing.

pagerbot: [02:07:41 UTC] Deploy monitor: smoke check 25% -> OK. p99 1.05s, errors 0.18%.

deploy-bot: step 2 complete. moving to 50% after 5m hold.

kevin_release: remind: keep an eye on long tail latency and tokenization pipeline on payment-worker queue. if p99 > 1.2s on payments, pause and roll back.

pagerbot: [02:14:22 UTC] Alert: payments-pay-worker p99 latency spike to 1.9s, error rate up to 0.9% (rolling 1m). Source: backend B-3.

amy_sre: pausing tilt. can we hold at 25% and drain new sessions?

deploy-bot: acknowledged. pausing rollout at current step (25%). initiating partial rollback of router nodes in cohort to 10% tilt.

jordan_platform: I've toggled cookie affinity and pinned traffic to previous pool for sessions older than 2m.

chris_engineering: digging into B-3 logs, seeing increased GC pauses after the new routing path. possible memory pressure from new header handling.

kevin_release: decision call: revert to 0% for safety. we'll mark v2.5.4 as blocked for payments workload and open an incident. schedule a canary with additional tracing after fixes.

deploy-bot: initiating full rollback to registry.redwood/router:v2.5.3 for payments route. steps: 25% -> 10% -> 0% with immediate drain bypass for rollback.

pagerbot: [02:23:59 UTC] Rollback progress: 25% -> 10% complete.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. router traffic restored to previous baseline (0% tilt).

amy_sre: verified. payments p99 back to 420ms, error rate 0.08%. all clear for now.

kevin_release: filing postmortem and release notes snippet: blocked v2.5.4 for payments; root cause suspected GC/memory handling on header parsing path. action items: add memprofiling, increase warm nodes in next canary, and run a targeted load test on B-3 shape.

jordan_platform: I've pinned router-service for payments to v2.5.3 in routing-table until next rollout. Added annotation `blocked: v2.5.4-payments-2026-03-21`

chris_engineering: adding debug flags to a dev cluster to reproduce GC pattern. tagging @kevin_release for follow-up.

kevin_release: thanks all. i'll post the release note and schedule a narrower canary after fixes. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
